overview: The Medford Dog Park Committee reviewed park finances, discussed upcoming capital projects including a new storage shed and security camera system, and considered off-leash dog policies and community outreach efforts.

items.title: Financial Update
items.summary: Theresa Dupont presented a financial update showing approximately $16,340 available in Stanton Foundation grant funds that must be allocated for park improvements by June 30.

items.title: Storage Shed Project Update
items.summary: The committee confirmed that Salt Spray Sheds has been contracted to build a replacement storage shed scheduled for installation in mid-June.

items.title: Security Camera Installation and Capital Upgrades
items.summary: The committee evaluated security camera quotes ranging from $12,000 to $18,000 to address vandalism and discussed using remaining grant funds for dog agility equipment or path maintenance.

items.title: Off-Leash Dog Hours Discussion
items.summary: Members reviewed community feedback from a recent Parks and Paths meeting regarding a proposed pilot program for designated off-leash dog hours in city parks.

items.title: Waste Management and Surveillance Signage
items.summary: The committee discussed general cleanliness at the park and agreed to post signs indicating the area is under camera surveillance.

items.title: Social Media and Promotion
items.summary: The committee discussed consolidating control over dog park social media pages to share official updates and distinguish committee communications from fundraising efforts.

items.title: Public Feedback and Proposed Survey
items.summary: Patrick Hogan relayed submitted public comments regarding park capacity limits and rules for unneutered dogs, prompting the committee to plan a public user survey.
